'''Lyn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]] who served as a [[Secretary/Legends|secretary]] to [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] [[Dixton]] of the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]]. He was aboard the [[Curich-class shuttle|''Curich''-class shuttle]] ''[[Resurgence (Curich-class)|Resurgence]]'' when it was forced to land on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abonshee]].<ref name="Godking" />
